pr_title: tasks: Provide environment variable autocomplete for tasks modal
pr_body:
Fixes #12099

![image](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/24362066/a492b53f-7f33-4281-a931-c44bca150c94)


Release Notes:

- Added autocomplete for environment variables to task modal
pr_comments: I'll close this out as a bunch of people expressed concerns internally over the clarity of having autocomplete in this modal. @iamnbutler suggested using inline completions, but that suffers from not surfacing multiple options and docs for them (though I agree that it would look/feel better).
